capabilities.description: Android only: an export's Save to folder (src/sheet/download.ts), the system save picker and a write into the document the player picked. Nothing else from either plugin: never dialog ask, confirm or message (the app shows no native dialog) and no fs read, list or delete. Guarded by test/download-platform-route.test.tsx.

Windows app only: the update banner's Install the update (src/sheet/UpdateNotice.tsx). Check the newest release's latest.json, download the installer it names (its signature is checked against the pubkey in tauri.conf.json) and run it. Check, download and install only. Guarded by test/update-button.test.tsx.
